title: VTG Ringling Bros Barnum Bailey Circus Program 98th Season 1968 Souvenir
categoryName: Collectibles:Historical Memorabilia:Fairs, Parks & Architecture:Circus & Carnival:Programs & Posters
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Ringling Bros Barnum Bailey Circus program from the 98th season in 1968. This souvenir item captures a piece of historical memorabilia from the world of circus and carnival. The program likely includes information about the acts and performers featured during that season, providing a glimpse into the entertainment of the era. It would be a valuable collectible for fans of circus history or vintage memorabilia.
